MH_01_easy.reference_interpolation: Shortest-arc SLERP; integer-nanosecond brackets; no extrapolation.

vqf_clock.policy: Nominal 200 Hz VQF clock; unchanged IMU samples, no interpolation or resampling.

primary_attitude_protocol.selection: Vicon recordings except V1_01_easy, whose canonical orientation is known to be inaccurate.
primary_attitude_protocol.reason: Machine Hall orientation was reconstructed using IMU data and is not an independent attitude reference.
primary_attitude_protocol.coverage: Five Vicon recordings overall; four in the validation split.
primary_attitude_protocol.metric_reason: The vehicle model targets inclination; six-axis yaw is unobservable and heading/total can be dominated by bias drift.
primary_attitude_protocol.reference_limit: All published state references include offline IMU fusion; Vicon additionally observes optical orientation.

build_description: Release build on macOS 27.2 arm64 with Apple clang 21.0.0, C++17, warnings treated as errors, patched Eigen 3.2.8, UKF double precision and Python 3.12.16.
